records.name: The Pit Emperor
records.brief: Broad muscular oxblood DEMON with an exposed, unmistakably nonhuman face: wide heavy square jaw, flattened batlike nose, two short upward tusks and small amber eyes beneath a thick brow. NO beard, human stone face or pointed chin. Two huge swept ram horns grow out sideways, forming a low wide silhouette, not a tall spike crown. Black iron armor with brass trim over red demonic flesh, short crimson mantle. Huge single-edged infernal cleaver held low, other clawed hand casts a contained flame. Heavy claw feet. Keep armor regal and formidable.

records.name: The Hellmouth Regent
records.brief: Tall lean regal DEMON with a long wedge-shaped reptilian face, smooth dark crimson skin, four yellow eyes (two pairs), and a sharply split fanged jaw. NO human face, beard, skull, or helmet. Four swept-back black horns form a streamlined crown; longer neck clearly visible. Elegant black and aged-gold segmented armor, narrow waist, long split crimson tabard, a thick barbed tail curls visibly to one side. Serrated obsidian sword held low and a long clawed casting hand. Clearly demonic aristocrat, predatory and cunning; two arms two legs, no wings.

records.name: The Ashwing Overlord
records.brief: A massive demonic warlord with a short monstrous face like a snarling predatory bat: flared nose, broad mouth of large fangs, deep-set ember eyes, rough charcoal hide. NO human face or beard. A pair of thick forward-curving bull horns, asymmetric broken horn tip. Short folded leathery wings behind shoulders create a broad upper silhouette, their fingers tipped brass. Black iron and oxblood royal armor, brass waist emblem shaped like a demon claw instead of a chest diamond. Massive flaming executioner sword held low in one hand, free taloned hand. Cloven armored hooves. Dominant brutal winged demon king.

records.name: The Sepulcher King
records.brief: A death-aligned frost monarch as an armored REVENANT. His face is an exposed elongated ivory human skull with no skin, no beard, hollow nose and two tiny cold blue soul lights in sockets; expression impassive. A low broken iron coronet frozen into the skull, no tall crystal crown. Broad blackened steel plate edged with a few big ice blades, ribcage-shaped silver breastplate with a sealed funerary emblem instead of a diamond. Tattered navy burial mantle. Huge straight frost greatsword held low, free skeletal gauntlet. Two armored planted feet. Regal dead king, restrained and severe, non-gory.

records.name: The Soul Gaoler
records.brief: A tall death-aligned frost ruler with NO visible face: deep black hood and featureless funerary mask of smooth pale ice, a single narrow vertical cyan fissure instead of eyes/nose/mouth. Hood framed by three blunt broken crown prongs, not antlers. Broad tombstone-shaped dark armor, one high icy pauldron and one lower chainbound shoulder, ragged dark teal shroud. A small caged spectral soul glows through an oval chest reliquary, NOT a diamond. Heavy ice executioner's sword held low; other hand holds one large iron soul-lantern on a short chain, containing a simple faint spectral face. Gaunt two-legged grounded silhouette, ominous jailer of the dead, no gore.

records.name: The Pale Reaper
records.brief: Death-aligned frost sovereign with a distinct exposed mummified face: pallid blue-grey taut skin, hollow cheekbones, blind white eyes, lipless closed mouth, clean-shaven bald head. No skull face, beard, human heroic stone face or conventional helmet. A crescent-shaped broken crown behind the bald head like a funerary halo, attached to neck armor. Long black-blue royal coat of armor with overlapping bone-colored ribs and restrained frost edging, heavy layered torn burial cloth, skeletal fingers. A tall single crescent ice scythe held at his side, the full blade clear in frame, other hand conjures one tiny stylized soul. Elegant, terrifying ruler of winter death; two planted armored feet.
